title: Scaling Diffusion Language Models via Adaptation from Autoregressive Models

contributions.purpose: 克服从零训练大规模文本扩散语言模型(DLM)资源消耗巨大、且规模远小于自回归(AR)模型的问题,利用现成开源 AR LLM 构建 DLM
contributions.mechanism: 提出简单的持续预训练适配方案:统一 AR 与扩散的建模目标(§3.2),用注意力掩码退火(attention mask annealing)打破 AR 的因果掩码使其双向化,继承 AR 的 shift operation,并采用无时间嵌入架构
contributions.evaluation: 在 FineWeb/SlimPajama 上以 <200B tokens 将 GPT2(127M-355M)和 LLaMA2(7B)转换为 DiffuGPT/DiffuLLaMA;DiffuGPT 在多数任务上优于 GPT2
contributions.domain: 自然语言处理 / 文本生成 / 扩散语言模型
contributions.source_quote: We demonstrate that by narrowing the gap between AR models and DLMs, it is possible to con-vert 127M-7B AR models (GPT2 and LLaMA2) into DiffuGPT and DiffuLLaMA with training on less than 200B tokens. Notably, DiffuGPT outperforms GPT2 in most tasks.

contributions.purpose: 证明将适配扩展到 7B 规模能显著提升 DLM 能力,得到当前最强 DLM
contributions.mechanism: 将 7B AR 模型(LLaMA2)适配为 DiffuLLaMA,评估其上下文学习、代码生成、infilling 能力及生成速度
contributions.evaluation: DiffuLLaMA 成为 SOTA DLM,展现 ICL、代码生成、强 infilling;无条件生成 1024 tokens(256 扩散步)速度与 AR 相当。数学 few-shot: MAWPS 31.3, SATMath 23.6, TriviaQA 20.9
contributions.domain: 自然语言处理 / 大语言模型
contributions.source_quote: We adapt 7B AR models to DLMs, greatly expanding the expertise compared to smaller-sized diffusion models. DiffuLLaMA emerges as the state-of-the-art DLM, exhibiting in-context learn-ing, code generation, and strong infilling capabilities.

contributions.purpose: 为 DLM 研究提供公平比较的基准与可复用资源
contributions.mechanism: 构建综合基准并开源适配后的扩散模型(127M/355M/7B)及适配代码、高效微调脚本、评估工具包
contributions.evaluation: 定性:发布 DiffuGPT/DiffuLLaMA 模型套件与配套代码工具(https://github.com/HKUNLP/DiffuLLaMA)
contributions.domain: 自然语言处理 / 开源工具与基准
contributions.source_quote: We provide a comprehensive benchmark for DLMs and release our adapted diffusion models (127M,355M and 7B) along with open-source adaptation code, efficient fine-tuning scripts,and evaluation toolkits.

self_declared_provenance.quote: By connecting text diffusion models with pre-trained masked language models (MLMs; Devlin et al. 2019), Ye et al. (2023); He et al. (2023) initialize discrete diffusion models using MLMs. ... However, the adaptation of diffusion models from AR LLMs remains unexplored.
We build on the formulation of absorbing discrete diffusion (Austin et al.,2021), which specifies Q_t=(1-beta_t)I+beta_t*1m^T.
This strategy aligns with recent trends where new models are scaled up or adapted to new architectures using existing LLMs (Wang et al.,2024;Zhang et al., 2024c).

notes: 存在明显 trade-off/负结果:DiffuLLaMA 在 zero-shot 上远逊于 LLaMA2(MAWPS 9.7 vs 63.5, SATMath <1 vs 24.5, TriviaQA 18.5 vs 45.4),需 few-shot/self-consistency 才缩小差距;论文明确承认从 MLM 适配的前人方法(Ye et al. 2023)会丢失基座能力。定位为『competitive with AR counterparts』而非超越。连续扩散 Plaid 1B 在条件生成任务表现不佳但无条件生成有优势——作者据此论证 perplexity 评估不足。
